questions.stem_latex:
Feifei ($F$) and Airi ($A$) are on opposing sides of a river bank. Feifei can run at a rate of 7km/hr and row at a rate of 5km/hr. The river bank is 800 metres wide and there would be 2.5 kilometres between Feifei and Airi if they were on the same side of the shore. Feifei wishes to meet Airi. Let $x$ be the distance from directly opposite from Feifei's starting point to her exit point ($E$) from the water and let $t$ be the total time taken for Feifei to meet Airi.

\exfigure{572_q25_1}

parts.label: a
parts.latex: Show that the time ($t$) taken for Feifei to row and then run to Airi can be given by the equation $t=\dfrac{2.5-x}{7}+\dfrac{\sqrt{0.64+x^2}}{5}$.

parts.label: b
parts.latex: Hence, or otherwise, find how far Feifei must run along the shore in order to minimise the time taken to reach Airi. Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.

solutions.latex:
$$\begin{aligned}y&=\sin\left(2x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)\\\frac{dy}{dx}&=2\cos\left(2x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)\end{aligned}$$

$$\begin{aligned}2\cos\left(2x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)&=0\\\cos\left(2x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)&=0\\\left(2x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)&=\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}\\2x&=\frac{\pi}{6},\frac{7\pi}{6}\\x&=\frac{\pi}{12},\frac{7\pi}{12}\end{aligned}$$

when $x=\dfrac{\pi}{12}$, $y=\sin\left(2\times\dfrac{\pi}{12}+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=1$

when $x=\dfrac{7\pi}{12}$, $y=\sin\left(2\times\dfrac{7\pi}{12}+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=-1$

$$\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}=-4\sin\left(2x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$$

when $x=\dfrac{\pi}{12}$, $\dfrac{d^2y}{dx^2}=-4\sin\left(2\times\dfrac{\pi}{12}+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=-4\to\left(\dfrac{\pi}{12},1\right)$ is a relative maximum turning point

when $x=\dfrac{7\pi}{12}$, $\dfrac{d^2y}{dx^2}=-4\sin\left(2\times\dfrac{7\pi}{12}+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=4\to\left(\dfrac{7\pi}{12},-1\right)$ is a relative minimum turning point

$$\begin{aligned}\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}&=-4\sin\left(2x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)\\-4\sin\left(2x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)&=0\\\sin\left(2x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)&=0\\\left(2x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)&=0,\pi,2\pi\\2x&=\pi-\frac{\pi}{3}\text{ or }2\pi-\frac{\pi}{3}\\2x&=\frac{2\pi}{3}\text{ or }\frac{5\pi}{3}\\x&=\frac{2\pi}{6}\left(=\frac{\pi}{3}\right)\text{ or }\frac{5\pi}{6}\end{aligned}$$

when $x=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$, $y=\sin\left(2\times\dfrac{\pi}{3}+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=0$

when $x=\dfrac{5\pi}{6}$, $y=\sin\left(2\times\dfrac{5\pi}{6}+\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)=0$

$\therefore$ Points of inflection are $\left(\dfrac{\pi}{3},0\right)$ and $\left(\dfrac{5\pi}{6},0\right)$

$$\begin{aligned}t&=\frac{2.5-x}{7}+\frac{\sqrt{0.64+x^2}}{5}\\t&=\frac{2.5-x}{7}+\frac{1}{5}(0.64+x^2)^{\frac{1}{2}}\\\frac{dt}{dx}&=-\frac{1}{7}+\frac{1}{5}\times\frac{1}{2}\times2x(0.64+x^2)^{-\frac{1}{2}}\\&=-\frac{1}{7}+\frac{x}{5\sqrt{0.64+x^2}}\end{aligned}$$

Stationary points occur when $\dfrac{dt}{dx}=0$

$$\begin{aligned}-\frac{1}{7}+\frac{x}{5\sqrt{0.64+x^2}}&=0\\\frac{x}{5\sqrt{0.64+x^2}}&=\frac{1}{7}\\\frac{x}{5}&=\frac{\sqrt{0.64+x^2}}{7}\\\frac{7x}{5}&=\sqrt{0.64+x^2}\\\frac{49x^2}{25}&=x^2+0.64\\49x^2&=25x^2+16\\24x^2&=16\\x^2&=\frac{16}{24}\\x&=\pm0.8164965809\\&=0.82\ (2\text{dp})\quad\text{since }x>0\end{aligned}$$

\extable{572_q25_t1}

$\therefore$ when $x=0.816\ldots$ the minimum amount of time is taken for Feifei to reach Airi.

Feifei must run $2.5-0.816\ldots=1.683503419$

$=1.68\text{ km}\ (2\text{ d.p.})$
